From: Asha Patel <security@fintrust.com>

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: brief timeline + SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 artifacts request re: auth anomaly

Hi Nikhil,

We observed anomalous authentication attempts against a small set of FinTrust service accounts that integrate with Redwood last week and need to confirm scope and timeline. Our security team is preparing a short due-diligence package for our board and auditor (AuditSolutions) and we need the following from Redwood by COB Wednesday:

- A short timeline of the event as you understand it (first detection, containment actions, current status)
- IR plan / post-incident summary that you can share (sanitized is fine)
- SIG/CAIQ evidence mapping for relevant controls (auth, logging, incident handling)
- Telemetry extracts (sanitized logs or a hashed extract) for 2027-06-24 through 2027-06-28

We have an NDA in place with Redwood; if preferred, we can provide a secure upload link or PGP for artifacts. I've attached a one-page fintrust_incident_summary.pdf with what we saw.

This is time-sensitive — could you confirm receipt and an ETA?

Thanks,

Asha Patel
Head of Security, FinTrust Payments
security@fintrust.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: brief timeline + SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 artifacts request re: auth anomaly

Asha — thanks for the heads up and for the summary. Confirmed receipt.

High level: we are treating this as an authentication anomaly (failed credential stuffing + one successful token reuse against a staging key that we immediately rotated). We have a live containment and telemetry collection effort underway. We can produce the items you requested but want to align on scope and delivery channel. Proposed next steps:

1) We will prepare a redacted post-incident summary (IRP + timeline) and a scoped telemetry export for the timeframe you listed.
2) Security artifacts (SIG/CAIQ mapping and SOC 2 references) — we can extract the relevant control evidence and provide a matrix.
3) Transfer method: secure S3 link with scoped access or our encrypted transfer portal. If you prefer AuditSolutions or an auditor to pull directly, we can grant time-limited access.

Can you confirm: is the request covering only production tenant 'fintrust-prod' or also staging/test tenants? Also, please confirm if AuditSolutions (Mike Reynolds) should be included when we push artifacts.

We're aiming to deliver the initial IR summary and a secure artifact bundle by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-30). I'll loop in Marissa for the evidence package and Jonas for the telemetry extraction.

Thanks — more shortly.

Best,

Nikhil Sharma
Security Response Manager
Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Thanks Nikhil — production only (fintrust-prod). Please include AuditSolutions on the artifact delivery so they can validate evidence for our SOC 2 auditor.

I've attached a brief evidence wishlist to make the QA faster:
- Redacted IR timeline (high-level: detection, containment, root cause, mitigation, lessons learned)
- List of rotated keys and time of rotation
- Telemetry extract: auth/login events, token exchange, IPs hashed, and related request IDs for 06/24-06/28
- SIG-Control mapping for: IAM-1, LOG-2, IR-3, SC-5 (or equivalent CAIQ rows)
- Any temporary exceptions or SLA impacts to FinTrust during the window

If you can provide the telemetry as a zipped CSV with a checksum and a separate manifest, that will help AuditSolutions. We can provide a temporary S3 bucket for upload if you prefer — let me know and I'll share credentials.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Asha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Asha / Mike — attaching the materials we discussed and summarizing the handoff here. Thanks for the patience while we completed the extraction and redaction pass.

Summary (high level) — Redwood findings and actions- First detection: 2027-06-25T23:44:12Z — abnormal token use pattern against a single long-lived staging key.- Containment: rotated the affected key (2027-06-26T01:12:05Z), blocked associated IPs, and forced session invalidation for impacted tokens.- Root cause: credential stuffing against an outdated staging key; no evidence of customer data exfiltration from production systems.- Current status: containment complete; no active indicators in prod as of 2027-06-29.

Delivered artifacts (attached / links):
- redwood_irp_summary.pdf (sanitized incident timeline and postmortem)
- telemetry_extract_20270628.zip (hashed IPs, request_id column, auth events; checksum included in manifest)
- sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx (mapping of Redwood controls to SIG/CAIQ rows and SOC 2 references)

Delivery method: artifacts uploaded to a time-limited S3 link (shared below). Access is scoped to the fintrust-prod account and AuditSolutions (Mike) for 7 days. If you prefer a different transfer, we can revoke and reissue.

Secure links and references:
- Telemetry/artifacts (S3): https://s3.redwood.example/secure/fintrust/telemetry_20270628.zip
- HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.example/deal/HS-004587 (for audit trace)

- Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet AuditSolutions' needs.
- If Mike or your SOC 2 auditor needs direct access to additional logs or a secured walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-minute session this week.
